summary: Iteration 10 testing completed for Admin Settings and Payroll features. All 14 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified - Settings page shows all 4 sections (Sales Tax, Service Prices, Contractor Pay Rate, Truck Rental Prices) with edit functionality. Payroll page shows dynamic pay rate from settings and has Payment History & Pay Stubs section (no data yet as no contractor jobs completed).

backend_apis: GET /api/admin/settings - Returns all settings (pay_per_stop, sales_tax, services, truck_rental_prices)
PATCH /api/admin/settings/sales-tax - Updates sales tax rate (validated 0-1 range)
PATCH /api/admin/settings/sales-tax - Rejects invalid values (>1 or negative)
GET /api/admin/payroll/pending - Returns pending payments with correct pay rate
Payroll calculations use pay_per_stop rate from settings
PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id}/reschedule - Stores SMS in customer_messages collection
frontend_ui: Settings page loads with Admin Settings header
Sales Tax Rate section with input (8.25%) and Save button
Service Prices section showing 7 services with prices and Edit buttons
Contractor Pay Rate section with Pay Per Stop input ($11) and Save button
Truck Rental Prices section with Small Truck ($75/week) and Large Truck ($125/week) inputs
Payroll stats cards show: Pending Payments, Unpaid Stops, Per Stop Rate ($11.00)
Per Stop Rate on Payroll page matches settings value
Payment History & Pay Stubs section present
